sourceBrief: Create a memorable AutoPromote welcome film and social campaign from an idea alone, with no recorded footage. Show imagination becoming finished work, rather than a feature list.
prompt: One blank ivory folded sheet unfolds into a miniature architectural city on a dark wooden desk, alleys and towers emerge as precise paper folds, one tiny path of warm amber light travels from the page toward a deep blue skyline. Cinematic impossible world born from ordinary raw material, tactile paper grain, photoreal macro commercial photography, crisp coherent architecture, dark quiet background, no writing, no logo, no screens.
